reviews.title: ExpressVPN – White Blank Screen Issue on iOS 27.0
reviews.text:
I am experiencing a recurring issue with the ExpressVPN app on iOS 27.0. Whenever I try to open the app, it displays a completely white blank screen and becomes unusable.

Reinstalling the app temporarily resolves the issue, but after a few days, the same problem occurs again. This has become extremely frustrating, especially for a paid VPN service.

I am experiencing this issue on both of my devices:

* iPhone 15 Pro Max – iOS 27.0
* iPhone 17 Pro Max – iOS 27.0

I have already raised a support case with ExpressVPN, but I have not received any response or resolution so far.

I expect better app stability and customer support from a premium VPN provider. ExpressVPN needs to investigate this issue and release a permanent fix for iOS 27.0 rather than leaving users to repeatedly reinstall the app

reviews.title: Disappointed - Connecting only 2 servers
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Very Disappointing After Paying for a Full Year

I paid for a full one-year ExpressVPN subscription because the service initially worked well and I expected a reliable premium VPN. Unfortunately, the experience has deteriorated significantly.

Currently, across all of my devices, ExpressVPN is connecting to only two servers. This is not what I paid for and severely limits the usefulness of the service.

What is even more frustrating is the customer support experience. I have raised this issue multiple times, but instead of actually resolving the problem, my complaints have been closed without a proper solution. The same issue continues.

For a paid annual subscription, I expect the service to function as advertised and, when there is a technical problem, I expect support cases to remain open until the issue is genuinely resolved—not simply closed.

I was satisfied with ExpressVPN when I first subscribed, but my current experience has been extremely disappointing. I would strongly urge ExpressVPN to investigate this properly, restore full server access across my devices, and address the way unresolved complaints are being handled.

Until this is resolved, I cannot recommend paying for a long-term ExpressVPN subscription.

reviews.title: No actual Customer Service
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for one year with varying degrees of success. It’s great for when you’re out of the country. Or connecting to public Wi-Fi, but many apps and websites won’t work when connected to the VPN. I realized that my subscription auto renewed. Yes you can see when you go into the date, it is set to renew however, I think it would be nice if the company sent an email to remind us that our subscription was about to renew opportunity to cancel or even to upgrade to a cheaper multi year plan. It had only been one day since my subscription auto renewed, I contacted Support through live chat. Waited forever. Then when the agent came on and introduced himself. He disappeared after that I kept reaching out to ask him if he was there. He finally said they were busy and he would try to help as soon as possible., Waited another 10 minutes then all he sent were the directions for renewing the subscription via the app and pieced out. So even though they claim 24/7 Support, it’s pretty much nonexistent. Canceled.

reviews.title: Was an awesome VPN at first
reviews.text:
Not sure if it’s just coincidence or what. First year with this VPN was good. I started getting timeout error and random disconnects and decided to cancel subscription. I didn’t notice it had just automatically renewed without me noticing any emails saying it was about to do so. Every other IP address from this app is banned from websites. Home Depot will randomly block me and I need to refresh the IP address or switch servers to get on it. Other websites insist on checking I’m not a bot every time I get on them which is highly annoying. My stupid time wasting games, you know the ones where just tap on things to build stuff, get frustratingly annoying because of IP addresses being swapped in the background. 

So, if you don’t mind continuously hitting the IP refresh button this could be the VPN you’re looking for. The app itself is solid from a laymen’s point of view. There is possibly some settings I could change to improve my experience but I don’t know enough to find them. This app is probably for the more experienced users. I do not recommend for those novice like myself who just don’t like to be tracked.
